purpose: Define the required real-process evidence before the two-relay reflection fixture can be marked executable.

seed.recipient: relay A actor or recognized follower collection

required_observations: Every remote actor and canonical-object GET is HTTP signed.
Every cross-relay inbox POST is counted by destination and activity ID.
Redis ready, delayed, claimed, retry, and retained-activity state is recorded for both relays.
The probe has a hard POST threshold that stops a runaway reflection cycle.
The report distinguishes delivery retries from newly generated relay Announce activities.
The report preserves logs and exact process configuration outside the repository.
promotion_rule: Only no_reflection_observed or an explicitly bounded reflection_settled result with documented limits may become a passing invariant. Active or threshold-reaching reflection requires a runtime loop-suppression fix first.
